overview.about: The Buick LPGA Shanghai brings the women's tour to one of China's greatest cities, played at the Qizhong Garden Golf Club. It is a key part of the LPGA's Asian swing and a showcase for the growing women's game in China.
overview.nextEvent: The next Buick LPGA Shanghai is played at Qizhong Garden Golf Club. The tree-lined parkland course hosts a strong international field on the tour's China stop.
